🚨 *GLOBAL POLICY TRIGGERS ALERT*
• *Source/Speaker:* US Senate / President Donald Trump
• *Announcement:* The US Senate has passed a bill \(Lindsey O\. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026\) authorizing President Trump to impose up to 100\% tariffs on Indian goods if India continues purchasing Russian oil and gas\. This legislation aims to curtail Russia\'s war funding and awaits passage in the House of Representatives\.
• *Market Stance:* 🔴 BEARISH

📊 *CONFIDENCE LEVEL:* MEDIUM \(70\% \- A bill authorizing up to 100\% tariffs has passed the US Senate\, but still requires House approval and presidential discretion for enactment\.\)

🎯 *INDIAN MARKET IMPACT:*
• *Vulnerable Sectors:* Textiles, Metals/Auto \(Auto Components\), Chemicals \(Specialty\, Agrochemicals\), Pharma \(Generics\, APIs\), EMS
• *Strategic Tailwinds:* None
• *Expected FII Sentiment:* Net Outflows \(The threat of substantial tariffs from a major trading partner like the US\, linked to geopolitical decisions\, creates significant export uncertainty and risk\-off sentiment for Indian equities\.\)

💡 *TACTICAL ACTIONABLE OUTCOME:* Fund managers should reduce exposure to Indian export\-heavy sectors\, particularly those with significant trade volumes with the US\, and prioritize domestic demand\-driven sectors\.
